title: Great Practice
content: I needed to phone Millway yesterday, I got a phone back almost immediately and a really helpful receptionist. I was referred to a Doctor who phoned me within a short time and then attended a clinic that morning. So efficient and helpful. Thank you Millway Medical Practice.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
